name: Gloria Anzaldúa
shortBio: Chicana feminist theorist and philosopher whose pioneering concepts of 'borderlands', 'mestiza consciousness', and 'nepantla' redefined continental feminism, epistemology, and queer theory.
centralQuestion: How can thinking from geopolitical, cultural, and embodied borderlands dismantle rigid dualisms and cultivate transformative pluralistic consciousness?

keyWorks.title: Borderlands/La Frontera: The New Mestiza
keyWorks.description: Groundbreaking text blending prose, poetry, and Nahuatl philosophy to articulate a theory of borderland identity and liminal epistemology.

keyWorks.title: This Bridge Called My Back: Writings by Radical Women of Color
keyWorks.description: Seminal intersectional anthology co-edited with Cherríe Moraga, centering the philosophical and political voices of women of color.

keyWorks.title: Light in the Dark/Luz en lo Oscuro: Rewriting Identity, Spirituality, Reality
keyWorks.description: Posthumously published philosophical treatise articulating the epistemology of conocimiento and transformative healing through nepantla.
